choices.content: Yes, because $y$ always has a value when $x$ is specified.
No, because when $x>0$, one value of $x$ corresponds to two values of $y$.
Yes, because $y=\pm\sqrt{x}$ is a single expression.

solutions.explanation: For example, when $x=4$, $y=2$ or $-2$. One value of $x$ corresponds to two values of $y$, which does not satisfy the requirement that each $x$ have a uniquely determined $y$. Therefore, it is not a function.
solutions.title: Test uniqueness with one input
